name: Mercedes SoC
author: hendkai
description: Mercedes-Benz state of charge in the bar — read-only connector daemon writes a local status cache, this widget renders it. No vehicle commands, no secrets in the bar process.

barWidget.description: Battery percentage, range and charging state of your Mercedes EQ

schema.label: Stale after (seconds)
schema.description: Mark vehicle data stale when it is older than this.

schema.label: Show range
schema.description: Show the electric range next to the battery percentage.

schema.label: Display mode
schema.description: Show either the numeric percentage or the charge-level bar.
